mutation MyMutation {
  createPaymentMethod(
    merchant_uid: "{{merchant_uid}}"

      ach: {
        account_type: BUSINESS_CHECKING
        address_line1: "1235 Testing Ave"
        account_number: "789456124"
        address_line2: "Apt 6"
        city: "Columbus"
        country: "USA"
        name_on_account: "Jim Smith"
        postal_code: "12345"
        region: "OH"
        routing_number: "021000021"
      }
      payor: {
        address_line1: "123 Testing Ave"
        address_line2: "Apt 2"
        city: "Cincinnati"
        country: "USA"
        email: "ashok@PaymentCompany.com"
        full_name: "Ashok Balla"
        merchant_uid: "{{merchant_uid}}"
        postal_code: "45140"
        region: "OH"
        phone: "5172079431"
      }
    }
  ) {
    address_line1
    address_line2
    card_brand
    city
    country
    exp_date
    full_name
    is_active
    last_four
    merchant_uid
    payment_method_id

    postal_code
    region
    wallet_type

      address_line1
      address_line2
      city
      country

      phone

      region

}
